Maya Li: Heads up team 10012 0Cloudport listing + co-hosted webinar. Need final assets for the marketplace page, a short benchmark blurb for the blog post, and to wire the inbound lead flow into SFDC before launch. Can we run a 20m smoke + rehearsal Wed 10am PT?
Jordan Cole: Wed 10am PT works. Main checklist: landing page copy, CTAs that pass click id, webinar slide deck + speaker order, and blog post draft.
Samir Patel: I'll take the blog draft and the benchmark section. Plan: a concise 3-bullet benchmark box and one chart. Proposal: 15% throughput gain for mid-sized catalogs and a 12% cost saving when using our prefix cache. Will keep the language conservative and include testing notes.
Ravi (Cloudport): Cloudport marketing is aligned. We can supply anonymized trace samples for validation and a 1-line partner quote for the blog. Our comms lead can review the listing copy by Tue EOD.
Ellen Park: For SFDC mapping 5ops please use exact field values. We'll also add a rule to route leads with `utm_medium=marketplace` to the partner SDR pool. Here's the mapping snippet Ops needs to implement: ```{ "lead_source": "cloudport_marketplace", "utm_medium": "marketplace", "utm_campaign": "cloudport_launch", "partner_account": "Cloudport", "owner_queue": "partners_sdr_pool"}```
Maya Li: Let's keep the registration form short: name, email, company, role, and one radio for interest (integration, marketplace, trial). Add an opt-in for partner follow-up. Samir 5 can you include a hidden `marketplace_click_id` so we can stitch back to listing clicks?
Samir Patel: Yes, will add hidden field and document param name in the asset pack. Also drafting the benchmark blurb now, will add a one-paragraph methodology note: "Internal Redwood + Cloudport tests on representative catalogs; results may vary."
Jordan Cole: marketing-bot, can you create a shortlink for the registration landing and set UTM defaults to utm_source=partner, utm_medium=marketplace, utm_campaign=cloudport_launch?
marketing-bot: Shortlink created: https://go.redwood/cloudport-launch. UTM defaults set as requested. Tracking pixel added to landing.
Ravi (Cloudport): We'll prepare the logo and approved co-branding lockups. Legal flagged one line about metrics; they'll sign off if methodology blurb is present.
Ellen Park: Post-webinar nurture: 1) Day 0 - thank you + recording, 2) Day 3 - benchmark one-pager + blog post link, 3) Day 10 - AE outreach. Please ensure the blog post includes an eval kit link for SDRs with talking points.
Maya Li: I'll draft the launch blog and coordinate blog + listing copy so messaging matches. Samir, need your chart PNG and the one-pager PDF by Tue noon to include in email 2.
Samir Patel: Chart and 1-pager PDF uploaded to the drive now. Also prepared a small alt-text summary for accessibility.
Jordan Cole: Demo notes we'll keep live demo to 6 minutes, and a 40s pre-recorded failover. Samir, can you prepare the perf graph screenshot sized for the listing hero?
Samir Patel: Uploaded hero screenshot under /cloudport/assets. Also included CSV of anonymized aggregated numbers for verification.
Ellen Park: Quick smoke test item: ensure marketplace CTA preserves query params across any redirects. If the marketplace requires a redirect, implement a client-side redirect that preserves `marketplace_click_id` and UTMs. Add this to the rehearsal checklist.
Maya Li: Added smoke test to rehearsal checklist in Notion and linked the assets. Also created draft blog and listing copy in the drive: https://redwood.app/drive/cloudport-listing-draft.
Ravi (Cloudport): Cloudport comms will review CTAs and meta description. We'll share final quote and logo by Tue AM.
marketing-bot: Reminder scheduled: Smoke + Rehearsal Wed 10:00 PT (channel #zoom-rehearsal). Also created Notion card for tracking: https://notion.redwood/board/cloudport-launch.
Maya Li: Action items recap: Samir - benchmark blurb + chart + 1-pager (due Tue 12:00). Jordan - slides + failover clip (due Tue EOD). Maya - blog + listing copy (due Tue EOD). Ellen - SFDC mapping and routing rules (due Wed AM). Ravi - legal + assets (due Tue AM).
Samir Patel: Noted. Will include methodology language and permission note from Cloudport in the 1-pager.
Ravi (Cloudport): Legal review in progress, ETA Tue AM. We'll include a short partner quote the same time.
Ellen Park: I'll push the SFDC mapping changes to staging and run a quick lead flow test after rehearsal. Add marketing-bot test lead generator to the checklist so we can simulate parameter passing.
marketing-bot: Test lead generator endpoint created: https://api.redwood/test-lead?marketplace_click_id=abc123&utm_campaign=cloudport_launch.
Jordan Cole: Great. I'll upload the pre-recorded demo clip to the drive and add timestamps for slide transitions.
Maya Li: Thanks team I'll post a final pre-read Tue morning with links to all assets. Keep benchmark claims conservative and make sure we include the methodology blurb on the listing and blog.
Ravi (Cloudport): Looking forward to the launch. We'll be on the rehearsal call.
Ellen Park: End state: listing live, blog posted, webinar ran, leads routed to partners SDR pool, and nurture cadence active. We'll confirm in this thread when the SFDC smoke test passes.
Maya Li: Closing now  will ping Tue AM with pre-read. :rocket:
